blocks.text: Fraser House Society, which was founded on October 13, 1967, initially operated as an in-patient addiction treatment program for male patients. However, in 1987, the society shifted its operations and started providing non-residential counseling and prevention services to the residents of Mission and the surrounding areas for anyone experiencing substance-use-related challenges, including youths and adults. The society aims to promote the development and implementation of effective prevention and counseling strategies to create a healthy community. Fraser House Society employs bio-psycho-social-spiritual and harm reduction approaches in its programs, aiming to serve clients at their personalized levels without imposing any particular treatment or recovery model.

blocks.text: Fraser House Society is a rehabilitation centre dedicated to providing comprehensive support to those who have been affected negatively by alcohol and drug use. The centre offers a range of individual, group, and family therapies to help those on their road to recovery. Those who wish to access the centre will find warm and welcoming staff who are committed to creating a supportive environment for each person who walks through the door. Additionally, Fraser House Society offers educational resources and community awareness initiatives to help build awareness around common issues related to alcohol and drug use. The centre’s hours of operation, from 8:30 am to 12 noon and 1 pm to 4:30 pm Monday to Friday, ensure that clients can access the support they need at a time that suits them best.

blocks.text: What sets Fraser House Society apart is the range of specialized treatments it provides to those recovering from substance abuse issues. Clients have access to both traditional and holistic therapies, tailored to each individual’s needs. These therapies include evidence-based practices, nutritional counselling, art and nature therapy, and yoga and meditation. The centre’s expert staff help clients learn positive coping skills, develop individualized wellness plans, and rebuild their lives through a holistic approach. Whether an individual needs therapy support individually, with their family, or in a group setting, Fraser House Society provides an inclusive and non-judgemental atmosphere designed to support each person along their path to recovery.

centre.name: Fraser House Society
centre.about_html:
Fraser House Society, which was founded on October 13, 1967, initially operated as an in-patient addiction treatment program for male patients. However, in 1987, the society shifted its operations and started providing non-residential counseling and prevention services to the residents of Mission and the surrounding areas for anyone experiencing substance-use-related challenges, including youths and adults. The society aims to promote the development and implementation of effective prevention and counseling strategies to create a healthy community. Fraser House Society employs bio-psycho-social-spiritual and harm reduction approaches in its programs, aiming to serve clients at their personalized levels without imposing any particular treatment or recovery model.

Governance and Funding

A voluntary board of directors governs Fraser House Society, representing the diversified local community. The society registers, as a Canadian charitable organization, under the Income Tax Act of Canada and earns its primary funding through the Fraser Health Authority.

Value Belief System

In line with its philosophy, Fraser House Society believes that all individuals must be given dignity, fairness, and compassion while recognizing that every person is capable of becoming responsible contributing citizens. Positive change towards creating a healthy community can be achieved by collaborating in bringing accessible quality services.

Fraser House Society- Center Overview

Fraser House Society is a rehabilitation centre dedicated to providing comprehensive support to those who have been affected negatively by alcohol and drug use. The centre offers a range of individual, group, and family therapies to help those on their road to recovery. Those who wish to access the centre will find warm and welcoming staff who are committed to creating a supportive environment for each person who walks through the door. Additionally, Fraser House Society offers educational resources and community awareness initiatives to help build awareness around common issues related to alcohol and drug use. The centre’s hours of operation, from 8:30 am to 12 noon and 1 pm to 4:30 pm Monday to Friday, ensure that clients can access the support they need at a time that suits them best.

What sets Fraser House Society apart is the range of specialized treatments it provides to those recovering from substance abuse issues. Clients have access to both traditional and holistic therapies, tailored to each individual’s needs. These therapies include evidence-based practices, nutritional counselling, art and nature therapy, and yoga and meditation. The centre’s expert staff help clients learn positive coping skills, develop individualized wellness plans, and rebuild their lives through a holistic approach. Whether an individual needs therapy support individually, with their family, or in a group setting, Fraser House Society provides an inclusive and non-judgemental atmosphere designed to support each person along their path to recovery.

• Art Therapy

• Cognitive Behavioral Therapy

• Physiotherapy

• Relapse Prevention Counseling

• Yoga

• Benzodiazepines

• Gambling

• Heroin

• LSD, psychedelics

• Marijuana (Cannabis)

• Methamphetamine

• Opioids

• Prescription Drugs

• Sex Addiction

• Synthetic Drugs

Aftercare

• Family Follow-up Counseling

• Follow-up Sessions (in-person)

• Recovery Coach

• Return Visits

• Support Meetings (on-site)

 

Amenities

• Air-Conditioned Rooms

• Bathroom Essentials (towels, soap, shampoo)

• Desk

• Fitness Center

• Gardens

• Housekeeping

• Outdoor Space

• Private or Shared Rooms

• Recreation Room

• TV

• Theater

• View

• Walking Trails

 

Activities

• Games

• Movies

• Physical Fitness

• Shopping

Special Considerations

• Executive Program

• Young Adults Program

Frequently Asked Questions About Fraser House Society

Who is Fraser House Society for?

Fraser House Society serves anyone who experiences substance-use-related challenges, including youths and adults, in Mission and its surrounding areas.

What type of treatment does Fraser House Society offer?

The society employs bio-psycho-social-spiritual and harm reduction approaches to provide customized treatment and recovery programs based on each client’s personalized needs.

What is the funding source for Fraser House Society?

Fraser House Society’s primary funding comes from Fraser Health Authority.

Does Fraser House Society have residential addiction treatment programs?

No, Fraser House Society provides non-residential counseling and prevention services to the residents of Mission and its surrounding areas.

How long has Fraser House Society been operating?

Fraser House Society has been operational since its establishment on October 13, 1967.

Is Fraser House Society accredited?

Fraser House Society has a recognized accreditation through the Accreditation Canada Healthcare Organization.

raw_html:
Fraser House Society, which was founded on October 13, 1967, initially operated as an in-patient addiction treatment program for male patients. However, in 1987, the society shifted its operations and started providing non-residential counseling and prevention services to the residents of Mission and the surrounding areas for anyone experiencing substance-use-related challenges, including youths and adults. The society aims to promote the development and implementation of effective prevention and counseling strategies to create a healthy community. Fraser House Society employs bio-psycho-social-spiritual and harm reduction approaches in its programs, aiming to serve clients at their personalized levels without imposing any particular treatment or recovery model.

Governance and Funding

A voluntary board of directors governs Fraser House Society, representing the diversified local community. The society registers, as a Canadian charitable organization, under the Income Tax Act of Canada and earns its primary funding through the Fraser Health Authority.

Value Belief System

In line with its philosophy, Fraser House Society believes that all individuals must be given dignity, fairness, and compassion while recognizing that every person is capable of becoming responsible contributing citizens. Positive change towards creating a healthy community can be achieved by collaborating in bringing accessible quality services.

Fraser House Society- Center Overview

Fraser House Society is a rehabilitation centre dedicated to providing comprehensive support to those who have been affected negatively by alcohol and drug use. The centre offers a range of individual, group, and family therapies to help those on their road to recovery. Those who wish to access the centre will find warm and welcoming staff who are committed to creating a supportive environment for each person who walks through the door. Additionally, Fraser House Society offers educational resources and community awareness initiatives to help build awareness around common issues related to alcohol and drug use. The centre’s hours of operation, from 8:30 am to 12 noon and 1 pm to 4:30 pm Monday to Friday, ensure that clients can access the support they need at a time that suits them best.

What sets Fraser House Society apart is the range of specialized treatments it provides to those recovering from substance abuse issues. Clients have access to both traditional and holistic therapies, tailored to each individual’s needs. These therapies include evidence-based practices, nutritional counselling, art and nature therapy, and yoga and meditation. The centre’s expert staff help clients learn positive coping skills, develop individualized wellness plans, and rebuild their lives through a holistic approach. Whether an individual needs therapy support individually, with their family, or in a group setting, Fraser House Society provides an inclusive and non-judgemental atmosphere designed to support each person along their path to recovery.

Frequently Asked Questions About Fraser House Society

Fraser House Society serves anyone who experiences substance-use-related challenges, including youths and adults, in Mission and its surrounding areas.

What type of treatment does Fraser House Society offer?

The society employs bio-psycho-social-spiritual and harm reduction approaches to provide customized treatment and recovery programs based on each client’s personalized needs.

What is the funding source for Fraser House Society?

Fraser House Society’s primary funding comes from Fraser Health Authority.

Does Fraser House Society have residential addiction treatment programs?

No, Fraser House Society provides non-residential counseling and prevention services to the residents of Mission and its surrounding areas.

How long has Fraser House Society been operating?

Fraser House Society has been operational since its establishment on October 13, 1967.

Is Fraser House Society accredited?

Fraser House Society has a recognized accreditation through the Accreditation Canada Healthcare Organization.
